details:
AstroVitals AI is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring system designed to improve astronaut safety during space missions. It tracks radiation exposure, bone health, sleep, heart rate, circulation, mental wellness, and space adaptation. Using machine learning and simulated health data, it detects unusual patterns and provides early alerts and recommendations. Benefits: Helps identify potential health risks early and supports better health monitoring during long-duration missions. Impact: Aims to make space exploration safer and support astronauts' well-being

Technologies Used: Python, Flask, React.js, SQLite

Innovation: Combines multiple astronaut health-monitoring features into one intelligent dashboard with mission simulation.
